title: FAA Private Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
releaseBlockers: the Seaplane and Aviation Weather Handbooks were not read: check that no card needs them
description: Private Pilot: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: FAA handbooks, the ACS and 14 CFR
notice: Contains material from 14 CFR parts 61, 91, 43, 39 and 68, 49 CFR part 830, the FAA Private Pilot for Airplane Category Airman Certification Standards, the Pilot's Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge, the Airplane Flying Handbook and the Aeronautical Information Manual, which are US Government works in the public domain. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed or approved by the Federal Aviation Administration or the U.S. Department of Transportation.

checks.what: Four independent audits read all 1,550 cards against the FAA handbooks, the ACS, the AIM and 14 CFR, which they quote word for word as found by the card checker, and reworked every calculation by hand
checks.result: 2 wrong cards were fixed and rechecked (a heading-calculation distractor and where an aircraft leaving the runway must be); 7 primers that said too little were re-sourced to the Aviation Weather Handbook, the AIM glossary and other FAA texts; the obstacle figure was redrawn to use the right symbol; 7 unsupported claims, 4 ambiguous cards, 14 unclear ones and 13 minor issues were also fixed.
